details.description: Grok 4.20 is a reasoning-capable chat model in xAI's Grok 4 series; xAI's release notes say Grok 4.20 and Grok 4.20 Multi-agent went live on March 10, 2026. `grok-4.20-beta-0309-reasoning` is xAI's API alias for the March 9, 2026 dated snapshot of the model, accepting text and image input and producing text output. xAI has since shipped newer Grok releases (4.3, 4.5, 4.6 and 4.7). Artificial Analysis, a third-party benchmarking site, lists this snapshot as deprecated in favor of Grok 4.3, though xAI's own May 2026 model-retirement guidance does not include Grok 4.20 among the models being retired or redirected.
advantages: Supports function calling, structured outputs and extended reasoning, per xAI's published model configuration.
Artificial Analysis measured about 101 output tokens per second for this model, faster than the 73 token/s median it reported for comparable models.
disadvantages: Artificial Analysis lists this model as deprecated, recommending xAI's newer Grok 4.3 instead.
xAI's reasoning-parameter documentation lists configurable effort levels for Grok 4.5, 4.6, 4.7 and the Grok 4.20 Multi-agent model, but not for this model.
use_cases: General-purpose chat and text generation through the xAI API.
Agentic or tool-using workflows via xAI's function calling and structured outputs support.
Tasks that combine image input with text, since the model accepts both text and image input.

sources.title: Grok Model Retirement on May 15, 2026 | SpaceXAI Docs
Grok 4.20 0309 v2 - Intelligence, Performance & Price Analysis | Artificial Analysis

notes: The catalog's 1M-token context window matches xAI's own model/pricing page for this model; Artificial Analysis's page for this model instead states a 2M-token context window, which I did not use. `grok-4.20-beta-0309-reasoning` and `grok-4.20-beta-0309` are the same underlying model in xAI's API config (both are aliases of xAI's `grok-4.20-0309-reasoning`); do not confuse either with the separate `grok-4.20-multi-agent` model.
